utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Mina, what kind of repairs are we focusing on first? I want to make sure I bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Bring your basic toolkit—screwdrivers, pliers, and a multimeter. We'll figure out the rest when we see what folks bring.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Alright, I'll grab my basic toolkit. Do you want me to also bring my spare parts box?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, need a hand with that repair drive? I've got some tools in my garage if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks Sam, but I'm still trying to figure out what we're fixing—community center roof or playground?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, I think it's for lawnmowers and small appliances—Ira was working on that. But I'm happy to help with whatever you need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Kira! We're meeting at the community center tomorrow at 10 to fix up the playground.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure we have all the parts? I heard we're missing the right screws for the casing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Don't worry, I'll ask around and see if anyone has those screws—we'll get it sorted tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye! I heard we're doing a repair drive — I've got some extra tools if you need any.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's great, Jules! We could definitely use those tools. Do you know what time you can come on Sunday? I'm putting together the volunteer schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, I can come in the morning, say around 9? I've got a hammer and some screwdrivers to contribute.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Cleo, are you planning to come to the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I heard from Rosa it's actually on Sunday now, not Saturday! I'll be there, and I'm helping gather tools. Can you bring any?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Sunday works better for me anyway! I can bring a set of screwdrivers and some spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah, shifts... sure, I can help with that. Just... remind me what day it is again?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's this Saturday, Noah! We're all set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: This Saturday? Got it. I'll mark my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hello Leo, it's going well. We're gathering tools and parts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Got the soldering iron I mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, Leo. That's one more checked off the list. Let's meet at the garage at 10 to sort everything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? They're fixing up old appliances and electronics.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, Tess, I heard. I'm a bit worried though—do we have a complete list of parts we'll need? Those screws can be tricky.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, don't worry! Sam's bringing his full tool kit, and Oren's got wrenches and hammers. I'm sure they'll have spare screws too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uli, I'm getting mixed messages about the repair drive—some say community center, others say park. Do you know where it actually is?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think I heard the community center, but I'm not sure. Sorry, I've been a bit distracted lately.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, I'll just have to double-check with the organizer. Thanks anyway.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Rey! Saturday at 9 AM at the park. Gloves, a wrench, or a hammer would be great if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay, I'll be there at 9 with my wrench and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Awesome, thanks Rey! See you Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, have you heard about the repair drive? I'm helping out with some lawnmower repairs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I've heard bits and pieces—Tess mentioned it, and Gus said he's helping with tools. What exactly is involved with the lawnmower repairs?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, I'm mostly dealing with spark plugs and a few wrenches. Gus mentioned that's what we need for the lawnmowers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Gus! The repair drive is this Sunday at the community center on Maple Street, from 10 AM to 4 PM. Can you spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Rosa! I'll tell everyone I see.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus! We could really use the help getting the word out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Welcome everyone! Just to clarify, the repair drive is this Sunday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks Rosa, I've got the location noted. I'll start working on the schedule from Opal's list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Faye! Let me know if you need me to send over Opal's list or if you have any questions.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: So which is it? Community center or park? I'm getting mixed messages.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I'm just as confused, Bo. I thought it was at the community center, but now I'm hearing different things.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I've got Vik saying community center and Mara saying park for the playground. No idea which one to go to.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I'm bringing a wrench and gloves on Saturday. Need me to find any other tools?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, did I already tell you I found a hammer and some wrenches? I'll bring those, but if you're looking for anything else, let me know—I might've forgotten!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No, that's good—sounds like we're set on tools. I'll see you Saturday at the community center with my wrench and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Whenever you're ready, just give me a shout. I can swing by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, I... maybe this afternoon isn't great. Can I let you know tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, tomorrow works fine. Just let me know when you're free, I'll make time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can look at the drive, but I'm still worried we don't have all the tools. Did we figure out who's bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Don't worry, Pia. Jules is bringing a hammer and screwdrivers, and Vik is coordinating everything at the community center tomorrow at 10.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's good to hear about Jules, but I'm still uneasy about the screws—those precision drivers I have might be the only ones that fit.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm helping with it. You bringing something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've got a broken lamp that needs a new switch. Think you can help me find the right part?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring it Saturday, we'll have parts.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I'd love to come! I can help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's fantastic, Nell! I'll send you the flyer and a list of items we're focusing on—let's get the whole neighborhood involved!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks Quinn! I’ll share it with my neighbors and see what old stuff I can dig up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey! Let me know what you find; every little bit helps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Cleo, I heard we're short on screws. Want me to check with Gus?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please! That would be a huge help. Gus might have some extras.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Jules, did you get a chance to look at the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I've been gathering some tools! I've got a hammer and screwdrivers if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So did you actually start fixing the drive, or just collect tools?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Hana! Glad to see you. Just a reminder, we're meeting at the park this Saturday at 9 AM for the playground repair.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Mara, I thought the repair meeting was at the community center tomorrow at 10? Let me check my notes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No, Hana, it's this Saturday at the park, 9 AM. The community center was never part of the plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Oh, right, the community thing. What are we fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Small appliances and electronics—like toasters, radios, that sort of thing. Sam's bringing his tool kit, and Oren's got some wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Small appliances, right. I think I have an old toaster somewhere... but I might've used it for parts already.
